outcome: Maternal outcomes (mode of delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, blood product transfusion)
Fetal outcomes (preterm delivery, birth weight, intrauterine fetal death, neonatal death)
cohort: All patients admitted with suspicion of placental abruption at 28 weeks of gestation and beyond from January 2013 to December 2017 in Dubai Hospital
finding: Placental abruption occurred in 0.61% of deliveries and was associated with a high rate of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including preterm delivery, low birth weight, and perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the mode of delivery in 78% of abruption cases.
